subject.title: refactor(prompt): use plain inbound context labels and drop system-tag sanitizer

question: Should externally supplied multiline system-event content be rendered as escaped/quoted continuation text, or should the queue normalize it to one safe event line before prompt rendering?
rationale: The PR intentionally removes the old text-rewriting sanitizer, but the replacement must preserve the invariant that untrusted event fields cannot create independent system-style prompt lines.

options.title: Restore shared continuation isolation
options.body: Use one queue or render-boundary rule that preserves event content without allowing raw continuation lines to render as separate `System:` lines.

options.title: Keep raw multiline event text
options.body: Accept that node, plugin, and generic queue callers may create additional system-style lines and document the resulting trust model.

recommendation.title: Restore shared continuation isolation
recommendation.body: Use one queue or render-boundary rule that preserves event content without allowing raw continuation lines to render as separate `System:` lines.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch author has the immediate implementation context; a security-boundary choice should still receive maintainer confirmation.
